messages:
carla: Quick heads up — onboarding flow broken in the Next starter and eval harness. New signups getting 401s and the frontend shows an infinite spinner. The LangChain/LlamaIndex Python example also imports the old package name.

sam: Can you paste concise repro steps + the exact server error?

carla: Repro: clone repo, cd examples/next-starter, yarn && yarn dev, click Test. Server log snippet: 
```
Error: 401 Unauthorized
    at fetch (/node_modules/node-fetch/index.js:123:15)
    at handleGenerate (/app/pages/api/generate.js:34:12)
Retrying request (1/3)
```
Also examples/python/langchain_demo.py has `from redwood import RedwoodClient` but our published package is `redwood_ai` and import path is now `from redwood_ai.client import RedwoodClient`.

sam: Sounds like two separate DX bugs: (1) starter env var/integration is outdated, (2) Python examples need modernized imports. @ben can you update docs and examples? I'll add a short config change in Node SDK to accept legacy env var names for one release.

devex-bot: CI started for branch fix/starter-onboard-2026 2 tests queued.

ben: I'll update README and add a compatibility table mapping old env names and import lines to current ones. Planning to add a small note about REDWOOD_DEBUG for routing diagnostics.

carla: Another issue: examples/eval/harness.py hitting 429 RateLimitError even for small runs. Debug showed routing fallback: 
```
routing: selected model 'gptx-3-large-q8' -> fallback to 'gptx-2' due to capacity
request.retries=3
```
Which causes quick retries and 429.

sam: Ok. Fix plan: a) Normalize env var names in the starter and accept legacy names in SDK, b) update example imports for Python/Node, c) add client-side retry cap in the starter so UI doesn't hang, d) add a test for the eval harness to detect routing fallback flapping. I'll target a patch today.

devex-bot: CI passed 2/42 checks. Deploy preview: https://deploy-preview-98--examples.netlify.app

carla: Verified preview. UI shows clear "missing key" hint and no infinite spinner. Eval harness is more stable but still sometimes hits 429 when region routing flips.

nina: Prioritize backport to v0.9 and add to release notes. Can you drop the backport PR link here when ready?

sam: Will do. Filing RFC to standardize package names across SDKs and adding a small section in the SDK release notes about compatibility. Also adding `REDWOOD_DEBUG=1` routing log guidance to the devex FAQ.

ben: README and example PRs opened: #98 adds compatibility table and troubleshooting. I'll cherry-pick to docs-site branch after CI.

carla: If anyone else runs into this, quick workaround: set both REDWOOD_API_KEY and REDWOOD_API_TOKEN env vars to the same value, and run with REDWOOD_DEBUG=1 to inspect routing.

nina: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" — please paste the backport PRs and RFC link once created so I can include them in the release notes checklist.
